messages.author: ac421cf36d1a4c37
messages.subject: temporary fix for lavaan incompatability
parts:
Hi All,

GenomicSEM is currently producing some errors related to the most recent lavaan version update. We're working on a fix, but in the meantime you can downgrade to lavaan version 0.6-21 as follows:

remotes::install_version(
  "lavaan",
  version = "0.6-21",
  repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org",
  dependencies = FALSE,
  upgrade = "never"
)

messages.author: d6d83e22ef3ba9f1
messages.subject: Re: temporary fix for lavaan incompatability
parts:
Hi All, 

This issue has now been fixed. If users redownload GenomicSEM, restart R, and rerun the code they can now use the latest version of lavaan with GenomicSEM. 

Thanks!
-Andrew
